$comment: Initial list: the largest carriers serving the UK/EU (not yet ranked by delay data). country = state that licensed the carrier. isEU = EU/EEA/CH carrier (EU261 inbound definition); isUK = UK-licensed. Scope logic uses `country`. claimFormUrl values were found on each airline's official site (October 2026) and must be checked by a human before setting verified=true; nothing with verified=false is shown to users. claimNotes: how to use that airline's claim route; shown only with a verified link.

airlines.name: Ryanair
airlines.claimNotes: Official EU261 compensation and expense form. Covers flights from the last 6 months; older flights go through Ryanair's help centre contact form.

airlines.name: Ryanair UK
airlines.claimNotes: Same Ryanair EU261/UK261 claim form as Ryanair DAC.
airlines.notes: Operates some UK-based Ryanair flights; check the operating carrier on the booking.

airlines.name: easyJet
airlines.claimNotes: Official easyJet EU261/UK261 claim form. Details can't be changed after submitting.
airlines.notes: easyJet UK. Flights sold as easyJet may be operated by easyJet Europe (EC) or easyJet Switzerland.

airlines.name: easyJet Europe
airlines.claimNotes: Same easyJet claim form.

airlines.name: Wizz Air
airlines.claimNotes: Wizz Air help centre page; claims are filed on the official claim platform (claim.wizzair.com). Wizz replies within 30 days; its 120% credit offer is not cash compensation.

airlines.name: Wizz Air UK
airlines.claimNotes: Same Wizz Air claim process as Wizz Air Hungary.

airlines.name: Lufthansa
airlines.claimNotes: Lufthansa online application for compensation and reimbursement of costs (EU261 Art. 7).

airlines.name: Eurowings
airlines.claimNotes: Eurowings claims FAQ linking to its online compensation claim tool (flight number, date, booking code, then bank details).

airlines.name: Air France
airlines.claimNotes: Air France claims page. Ask for cash, not the voucher Air France offers.

airlines.name: KLM
airlines.claimNotes: KLM compensation page with its online claim route.

airlines.name: Transavia
airlines.claimNotes: Transavia contact form; choose the category "Flight disruptions".

airlines.name: British Airways
airlines.claimNotes: BA delays and cancellations page linking to the Customer Relations online compensation claim form.

airlines.name: Vueling
airlines.claimNotes: Vueling help centre claims page (compensation for overbooking, delay or cancellation).

airlines.name: Iberia
airlines.claimNotes: Iberia claims page with separate forms for delayed and cancelled flights; needs booking code and ticket number.

airlines.name: Air Europa
airlines.claimNotes: Air Europa customer service claims form (Spanish-language page; language selector on the site).

airlines.name: TAP Air Portugal
airlines.claimNotes: TAP requests and complaints page leading to its online complaints form.

airlines.name: ITA Airways
airlines.claimNotes: ITA Airways flight disruptions page; claims go through its online contact form.

airlines.name: SAS Scandinavian Airlines
airlines.claimNotes: SAS dedicated EU261 claim form (delays, cancellations, denied boarding, downgrades).
airlines.notes: Verify the licensing state of the operating SAS entity (Denmark/Norway/Sweden); all are EU/EEA.

airlines.name: Norwegian
airlines.claimNotes: Norwegian claims page (delay or cancellation). Norwegian asks passengers to claim directly and allow 28 days.
airlines.notes: Some flights are operated by Norwegian Air Sweden (D8, SE).

airlines.name: Finnair
airlines.claimNotes: Finnair feedback and compensation page: "Submit a claim request for the flight disruptions". Finnair's page asks for claims within two months of the flight; the legal limitation period is longer.

airlines.name: Aer Lingus
airlines.claimNotes: Aer Lingus requests page; compensation goes through the Post Travel Enquiry form (expenses have a separate form).
airlines.notes: Aer Lingus UK (UK-licensed) operates some Belfast/Manchester routes.

airlines.name: SWISS
airlines.claimNotes: SWISS online application for EU261 compensation and expenses.
airlines.notes: Swiss carrier: EU261 applies via the EU–Switzerland air transport agreement. Not an 'EU carrier' for UK261 inbound.

airlines.name: Austrian Airlines
airlines.claimNotes: Austrian flight disruptions page linking to the application for compensation and reimbursement of costs.

airlines.name: Brussels Airlines
airlines.claimNotes: Brussels Airlines delays and cancellation contact form. Its conditions of carriage claim a one-year limit for court action under Belgian law.

airlines.name: Jet2
airlines.claimNotes: Jet2 online claim form for delays, cancellations and expenses; one form per disrupted flight.

airlines.name: TUI Airways
airlines.claimNotes: TUI flight delay claim web form (flight numbers starting TOM/BY/OR). ADR: AviationADR.
airlines.notes: Package holidays may also carry Package Travel Regulations rights (out of scope).

airlines.name: Volotea
airlines.claimNotes: Volotea online complaints form; one claim per passenger.

airlines.name: LOT Polish Airlines
airlines.claimNotes: LOT "Claim after departure" online form; LOT replies within 30 days.

airlines.name: Aegean Airlines
airlines.claimNotes: Aegean contact form; choose the category "Passenger rights (EC) 261/2004".

airlines.name: Turkish Airlines
airlines.claimNotes: No dedicated EU261 claim form found on turkishairlines.com. Write to Turkish Airlines customer relations; escalate to the enforcement body of the departure country.
airlines.notes: Non-EU/UK carrier: covered only on departures from the EU/UK.
